note: All comparator values and reduced payments in these distinguishing controls are synthetic inputs, not statements of actual 2026 SMI or new-award fee. Controls encode the cited published assessment and verify the Guide applies it consistently; they are not a new official simulator result.

controls.name: annual income one cent below comparator
controls.basis: TGSS Prórroga Tarifa Plana; current RD 44.3.f. This tests the expressly labelled published assessment, not an adjudicated legal-challenge result.

controls.name: annual income exactly at comparator
controls.basis: TGSS Prórroga Tarifa Plana; current RD 44.3.f. This tests the expressly labelled published assessment, not an adjudicated legal-challenge result.

controls.name: annual income one cent above comparator
controls.basis: TGSS Prórroga Tarifa Plana; current RD 44.3.f. This tests the expressly labelled published assessment, not an adjudicated legal-challenge result.

controls.name: initial unconditional period at equality
controls.basis: LETA 38 ter.6 first paragraph; new Guide expressly preserves initial-period exemption.

controls.name: two calendar years: below then equality, six extension months each
controls.basis: TGSS limits loss to the affected year; LETA 38 ter.2 requires each year separately. Twelve extension months total, not a 24-month general extension.

controls.name: two calendar years: equality then below
controls.basis: Same annual partition; no cross-year benefit removal.

controls.name: two calendar years: both equality
controls.basis: Separate annual comparisons with their respective comparator, not one blended threshold.

controls.name: annual gate first, then proportional affected-month numerator
controls.basis: LETA 38 ter.6 proportional-income sentence. Synthetic comparator 22000: full annual income equals it; comparing the proportional 11000 against the full annual comparator would give the wrong gate.

controls.name: six affected months, actual assessed monthly final 378 less actual reduced 90
controls.basis: Arithmetic reconciliation control only: both quotas are assumed actual assessment records. 90 is not a statutory 2026 reduced-fee assertion; 378 is the preserved full-coverage example output.

controls.name: varying affected-month actual final and reduced records
controls.basis: Existing signed monthly regularisation plus actual records; does not infer a universal flat fee or six identical debits.
